lines: Even tracing the days when I can't laugh
Even cursing the unchanging now
Words that drift in the air
They probably can't save you
The scenery that remains out of reach
The pain that never warms
We pressed our shoulders together and walked
So we could go to distant places
The hope you speak of
If it's the ideal you have longed for in your dreams
No matter how cold, I'll love you to prove it
Even tracing the days when I can't laugh
Even cursing the unchanging now
Words that drift in the air
They probably can't save you
Even shouting with a feeble voice
It changes into a night that burns with heat
Even if this hand lets go
So we can walk again
Words we never share
Each time we suddenly notice them, they keep growing
Facing the present, we change
I want you to watch that form
The future you speak of
Just doesn't fit in my hands
No matter how much I mend
I’ll end up doubting the depths of that smile
Even beyond the endless days
Even the sorrow too great to save
The more this finger struggles
The farther it will blur, I suppose
The color of feelings I can't touch
I thought I didn't want to know
Even if you're gone, I still want to dream
If the misfortune that resembles you attacks you
I want to feel you with the palm of my hand
If the words I mended and spat out curse someone
I'll keep my mouth shut
Even tracing the days when I can't laugh
Even cursing the unchanging now
Words that drift in the air
They probably can't save you
Even shouting with a feeble voice
It changes into a night that burns with heat
Even if this hand lets go
So we can walk again
Without saying goodbye
So that we can meet again somewhere
